title: Race, Ethnicity and Their Implication on Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: A mechanistic interpretability pipeline combining multi-class linear probing on the residual stream, neuron-level attribution using cosine similarity to locate race-encoding MLP neurons, and targeted intervention (activation steering via sign-flipping and amplification). The methodology evaluates both explicit demographic mentions and implicit proxy cues (like language or geography) using toxicity generation (ToxiGen) and clinical narrative classification (C-REACT) datasets.
